frozen: 2026-11-01, after addendum salmon9 and before any run below. Known when frozen: attempt 7 (sea-ice factor, salmon a 300, L 800 km, outlets 2-15 C) mends the coasts (CV 0.442 -> 0.372) but its Subarctic fold fails (0.437 -> 0.559); configuration D's Subarctic bias is +0.36 before any salmon, concentrated in the eastern, Algonquian half on the wet Canadian Shield (Cree, Ojibwa, Montagnais, Naskapi: +0.5 to +1.0 log10) while the drier Yukon and Mackenzie Athabaskans fit (-0.4 to +0.1); within the Subarctic the residual rises with satellite NPP (Spearman +0.64), i.e. the wettest, most productive boreal forest is the most over-predicted.
why: FORGE's prey supply is a fixed share of NPP everywhere. In closed forest most of the production goes into wood and litter, not into browse and graze, so the secondary (game) production per unit NPP is lower than in open country (Binford 2001's primary-biomass argument; boreal moose and caribou densities are low for their NPP). The Shield's closed spruce forest is the wettest part of the Subarctic.
change: the meat supply multiplied by (1 - c x W): W, the closed-forest share, = clip((AI - 0.5) / 0.5, 0, 1) where trees grow (warmest month >= 10 C), else 0; AI = annual rain / annual Thornthwaite PET from the group's monthly WorldClim climate (0.5 the dry-subhumid threshold, 1.0 humid; nothing fitted in W). Plants unchanged. Everything else as attempt 7 (configuration D, sea-ice factor, salmon streams with outlets 2-15 C and upstream thinning).
cross_validation: as addendum salmon7 (folds ARC, NNA, WNA, BC NWC, SW, rest of world), with (a_salmon, L, c) fitted on the other folds over a_salmon {0, 30, 100, 300, 1000}, L {100, 200, 400, 800} km, c {0, 0.3, 0.5, 0.7}; also reported: the forest factor alone (a_salmon 0).
adopt_if: against configuration D as adopted: the CV error improves by at least 0.02, no fold's held-out median absolute log10 error worsens by more than 0.05, and the rest-of-world fold's not by more than 0.01. Then the forest factor, the ice factor and (a_salmon, L, c) fitted on all groups enter data/foraging_model.json (the map: AI from its own monthly climate) and the atlases' foraging is rebuilt.
